name: metrics_execrp
description: Metrics of one execrp tile instance, one row per sweep

sample_id.description: Identifier shared by every row of one sweep

sample_slot.description: Slot that triggered the sweep, 0 for periodic sweeps

sample_snapct_state.description: Snapshot load state entered, for snapct_state sweeps; unknown otherwise

sample_caught_up.description: Whether replay had caught up to the cluster tip when the sweep was taken (replay IsCaughtUp); set once per run, never cleared

sample_tile_cnt.description: Tile instances in the sweep, to detect partial sweeps

kind_id.description: Index of this tile instance among tiles of its kind

tid.description: Thread ID of the tile. Same as Pid in production, but might differ in development

last_cpu_index.description: CPU the tile last ran on

context_switch_involuntary.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Involuntary context switches

context_switch_voluntary.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Voluntary context switches

page_fault_major.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Major page faults

page_fault_minor.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Minor page faults

heartbeat_time.description: Last wall-clock time the tile heartbeated

is_backpressured.description: Whether the tile is currently backpressured

backpressure.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Times the tile waited for one or more consumers to catch up to resume publishing

regime_duration_nanos.description: Tile wall time, by regime; regimes are exhaustive and groups Busy, Idle, Backpressure and Housekeeping partition it

thread_duration_nanos.description: Thread wall time since start, by scheduler state; Idle is the remainder, so parts sum to about the lifetime.  User, System and Interrupt have 10 ms resolution; Interrupt is 0 unless the tile is pinned

wait.description: Wait (task was runnable but not scheduled)

user.description: User (task was scheduled and executing in user mode)

system.description: System (task was scheduled and executing in kernel mode)

interrupt.description: Interrupt (CPU time stolen by hardirq/softirq handlers or a hypervisor; fixed tiles only)

park_attempted.description: Times the tile tried to park while idle (efficient mode), by result

pending.description: Pre-park recheck found work, did not park

device_irq.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Device IRQs on the tile's dedicated CPU, 0 for tiles not pinned

tlb_shootdown.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. TLB shootdowns on the tile's dedicated CPU, 0 for tiles not pinned

timer_irq.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Local timer interrupts (LOC) on the tile's dedicated CPU, 0 for tiles not pinned

is_processing.description: Whether the tile is currently processing a task (executing, sigverifying, or PoH hashing)

txn_processed.description: Transactions loaded and executed, by result

instruction_error.description: An error occurred while processing an instruction

account_not_found.description: The transaction fee payer address was not found

program_account_not_found.description: A program account referenced by the transaction was not found

insufficient_funds_for_fee.description: The transaction fee payer did not have balance to pay the fee

invalid_account_for_fee.description: The transaction fee payer account is not owned by the system program, or has data that is not a nonce

already_processed.description: The transaction has already been processed in a recent block

blockhash_not_found.description: The transaction references a blockhash that is not recent, or advances a nonce with the wrong value

invalid_program_for_execution.description: A program account referenced by the transaction was no executable.

address_lookup_table_not_found.description: The transaction references an ALUT account that does not exist or is inactive

invalid_address_lookup_table_owner.description: The transaction references an ALUT account that is not owned by the ALUT program account

invalid_address_lookup_table_data.description: The transaction references an ALUT account that contains data which is not a valid ALUT

invalid_address_lookup_table_index.description: The transaction references an account offset from the ALUT which does not exist

max_loaded_accounts_data_size_exceeded.description: The total account data size of the loaded accounts exceeds the consensus limit

duplicate_instruction.description: A compute budget program instruction was invoked more than once

invalid_loaded_accounts_data_size_limit.description: The compute budget program was invoked and set the loaded accounts data size to zero

nonce_already_advanced.description: The transaction references a nonce account that is already advanced

nonce_advance_failed.description: The transaction is a nonce transaction but the advance instruction was not valid or failed

nonce_wrong_blockhash.description: The transaction is a nonce transaction but the blockhash is not the correct one

unsupported_version.description: The transaction is a message version that is not supported by the current feature set

sanitize_failure.description: The process for sanitizing the transaction failed

account_in_use.description: The transaction conflicts with another transaction in the microblock.

account_loaded_twice.description: The transaction references the same account twice

signature_failure.description: The transaction had an invalid signature

too_many_account_locks.description: The transaction references too many accounts.

insufficient_funds_for_rent.description: The transaction would leave an account with a lower balance than the rent-exempt minimum

unbalanced_transaction.description: The total referenced account lamports before and after the transaction was unbalanced

bundle_peer.description: The transaction was part of a bundle and an earlier transaction in the bundle failed

account_lthash_skipped.description: Committed writable accounts left byte-identical by their transaction, so their lthash update was skipped; counted only when lthash is computed in band, zero with development.lthash_out_of_band on

txn_regime_duration_nanos.description: Time per transaction, by phase; a phase counts only once the next phase starts, so dropped, fees-only and no-op transactions lose their trailing phases

vm_regime_duration_nanos.description: Time in top-level BPF invocations, by phase, with CPI setup and commit split out; nested programs, including native CPIs, count as Interpreter; subset of TxnRegime Execute

cu_consumed.description: Compute units consumed by executed transactions

progcache_looked_up.description: Program cache lookups; equals Hit + Miss + lookups of invalid program accounts

progcache_miss.description: Program cache misses, each followed by an insert or a spill

progcache_waited.description: Program cache lookups that waited on another tile's in-flight load of the same program

progcache_insert_retried.description: Program cache inserts that found no free slot in their size class on the first try and retried after eviction

progcache_inserted_bytes.description: Bytes inserted into the program cache

progcache_spilled_bytes.description: Bytes loaded into program cache spill memory

progcache_evicted_bytes.description: Bytes evicted from the program cache by insert eviction sweeps

progcache_duration_nanos.description: Time in program cache lookups, including waits on peer loads and insert, eviction and ELF load on a miss; superset of ProgcacheLoadDurationNanos

progcache_loaded.description: Program ELF loads and verifications for the program cache, including failed verifications and spill-backed loads

progcache_hit.description: Program cache hits, by size class

progcache_inserted.description: Programs inserted into the program cache, by size class

progcache_evicted.description: Program cache slots reclaimed by an insert's eviction sweep, by size class (housekeeping preevicts are counted by the accdb tile)

progcache_spilled.description: Programs loaded into spill memory because no cache slot could be freed, by size class

accdb_account_readonly_acquired.description: Readonly accounts acquired from the account database, by cache size class of the account's current data size

accdb_account_writable_acquired.description: Writable accounts acquired from the account database, by cache size class of the account's current data size

accdb_account_evicted.description: Accounts evicted from the account database cache to make space, by cache size class

accdb_account_new_committed.description: New account versions committed to the index, by destination cache size class

accdb_account_overwrite_committed.description: Account versions committed over an existing version of the same fork and generation, by destination cache size class

accdb_account_cache_missed.description: Accounts not found in the account database cache and read from disk, by cache size class

accdb_account_waited.description: Accounts that had to wait for another reader to finish loading them into the cache

accdb_batch_acquired.description: Batch acquire calls made by this tile

accdb_cache_reserve_retried.description: Spin retries while waiting to reserve cache lines for a transaction

accdb_disk_read_bytes.description: Bytes read from the account database file

accdb_disk_read.description: Reads from the account database file

accdb_disk_written_bytes.description: Bytes written to the account database file

accdb_disk_written.description: Writes to the account database file

accdb_copied_bytes.description: Account data bytes copied in memory between cache lines, staging buffers and callers; disk reads excluded
